title: BONGARD-RWR+: REAL-WORLD REPRESENTATIONS OF FINE-GRAINED CONCEPTS IN BONGARD PROBLEMS

bias_targets.methodology: Expert annotators reviewed a subset of 800 generated images depicting humans and assigned labels for gender (Female, Male, Hard to tell) to analyze the demographic distribution.

Expert annotators reviewed a subset of 800 generated images depicting humans and assigned labels for race (Asian, Black, White, Hard to tell) to analyze the demographic distribution and identify racial imbalances.
